properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: The default value to return if the hook is being run on the server.

properties.name: initializeWithValue
properties.description: If `true` (default), the hook will initialize reading the media query. In SSR, you should set it to `false`, returning `options.defaultValue` or `false` initially.

returnType.name: boolean
returnType.description: The current state of the media query (true if the query matches, false otherwise).
